dogecoin.text:
Examples of Shitcoins

Some infamous (or just funny) shitcoins:
🔹 Useless Ethereum Token (UET)
🔹 Baby DogeCoin (BABYDOGE)
🔹 Dogelon Mars (ELON)
🔹 Rich Quack (QUACK)

Many started as jokes. Some as outright scams.

Not All Meme Coins Are Trash

Some meme coins evolve.
Dogecoin now facilitates peer-to-peer payments.
Shiba Inu has:

🔸 ShibaSwap (DEX)
🔸 Shibarium (Layer 2 chain)
🔸 SHIB Metaverse

Jokes can grow serious.

The Meme Coin Ethos

They thrive on:
✅ Internet virality
✅ Humor
✅ Community hype
✅ Social media momentum

Examples:
🔹 Dogecoin (DOGE)
🔹 Shiba Inu (SHIB)
🔹 Dogwifhat (WIF)
🔹 PEPE
🔹 BONK
🔹 BONE
